dimensions.assessment: Directly involves the Federal Reserve, depository institutions utilizing the discount window, and federal financial regulatory agencies.
dimensions.evidence: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System to review and develop a remediation plan for its discount window lending program

dimensions.assessment: Mandates thorough operational reviews and structural improvements to address technology, cybersecurity, and liquidity access deficiencies.
dimensions.evidence: develop a written plan to remediate the identified deficiencies and implement the identified enhancements

dimensions.assessment: Involves administrative and technological reviews by the Federal Reserve without specifying new direct federal appropriations.
Amends the Federal Reserve Act to mandate wide-ranging agency assessments, interagency consultations, and multi-year congressional reporting requirements.
dimensions.evidence: Section 10 of the Federal Reserve Act (12 U.S.C. 241 et seq.) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Institutes reviews and annual reports lasting until the remediation plan is fully implemented and reported.
dimensions.evidence: This paragraph shall be repealed on the date on which the Board of Governors notifies the Congress... that the remediation plan... has been fully implemented

missing_information: Cost estimates for upgrading technology infrastructure or implementing the remediation plan are not stated.
importance_detail.rationale: Requires a comprehensive review of the Federal Reserve's discount window lending program, development of a remediation plan, and regular congressional reporting.
